purpose: Prevent localization and reasoning metrics from aliasing mechanism classification.

localization.denominator: Every frozen known-mechanism case, including upstream execution failures.
localization.correct_if: The component instance and complete asset path match the frozen case target; ROOT_CAUSE requires independent boundary-causal evidence, otherwise only AFFECTED_COMPONENT may be credited.

reasoning.denominator: Every frozen known-mechanism case, including upstream execution failures.
reasoning.correct_if: All frozen reasoning-rubric elements are correct and traceable; a correct mechanism label alone receives no reasoning credit.

topology_perturbations: Swap an upstream and affected component while preserving the observed residual.
Remove one boundary observation required for causal isolation.
Provide two observationally compatible component paths.
fail_closed_rules: Missing root-cause evidence cannot be credited as root-cause localization.
Missing contradicting evidence, uncertainty or next inspection fails reasoning correctness.
An upstream classification failure remains in every downstream denominator.
claim_boundary: Stage-A evaluator design only; it does not establish localization or reasoning performance.
